obligations.title: Provide monthly status reports on progress, risks, issues, service levels and defect metrics.
Hold a monthly steering meeting with the delivery manager and programme sponsor.
Appoint a delivery manager as single point of accountability.
Appoint a programme sponsor and a product owner for each in-scope application.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures for personal data processed for the Customer.
Use anonymised or masked test data wherever reasonably practicable.
On expiry or termination, deliver all deliverables, return Customer materials and provide transition assistance.
